app_findings: The qualified 2.1 envelope (25/cfg1/euler/simple) must not be used for 3+ person cells: it silently drops a participant.
At cfg 1 the negative branch is inert, so male erect state/size control is unreachable in the app today.
The 2.1 graph hardcodes negative_prompt = '' - a configured, UI-backed negative text is required for state control.
Close-up prompts must require person anchors; 'the frame is filled by X' / 'alone in the frame' / 'only his lower torso and penis are in frame' produce a disembodied crop.
For coitus, name the male body parts present above the join.
Vulva legibility requires framing at hip-and-thighs or tighter; at full-length and medium-hip expect a slit.
